coverageNotes: Nairobi west/north-west group. Seed already holds roughly 150 venues in this bounding box, so most well-known gyms were already known; 17 candidates here are NEW (not in seed) and 20 are seed venues for which I found new address/phone/hours/website or a relocation. WebSearch is weak for Kenyan venues: results were dominated by hotel/apartment/property listings and a low-quality directory (achisystems.co.ke) whose entries look fabricated (placeholder addresses and emails), which I did NOT use. Many gym websites would not open from the sandbox (DNS failures for avfitness.ke, pumpfitness.co.ke, racingsportgym.com, fit4lifegym.co.ke, reform.co.ke 404, fluid.ke, corebalancestudio.co.ke, ritualstudio-ke.com; HTTP 403/503 for several hotel and directory pages), so several venues rest on 2+ directory pages or news articles instead of an own site. Area by area. Westlands: best coverage (new: W Exclusive, Reform, Jenga Fit, Kanga Studio, HIITZone, Body EQ, Fluid, Villa Rosa Kempinski and Movenpick hotel gyms; seed updates: Level 24, Mom3ntum, Heart to Heart, Siha, SmashFit, Progressive Park, King's Gym); many Westlands apartment-block gyms are residents-only and were ignored. Parklands: only Fit 4 Life, Racing Sport, Parklands Sports Club and the Diamond Plaza yoga centre found; Fitness Mania site returned an empty page. Highridge: no gym of its own found (VMX was wrongly attached to Highridge by one search; it is at Village Market, Gigiri). Lavington: Zarnash Gym (new), plus address updates for AV Fitness, Tuzidi, Bikram, Delight Hot Yoga, F45. Kileleshwa: very thin online; only Sante Wellness (Gramo Suites), Swiss-Belinn hotel gym, Calisthens Fitness Centre (2023 article, no contact) and seed Wentworth Gym. Kangemi, Loresho, Spring Valley: no gyms with an online presence found at all (searches returned only property listings); Loresho Health Club is a name-only lead. Kitisuru: Beyond Body (seed 'Burn Body'), details not verifiable on an opened page. Riverside: only the Ikigai Riverside spin studio (2022) and apartment/hotel gyms; X Fitness is an uncorroborated lead. Gigiri: VMX Fitness, UNON recreation centre (UN staff), CrossFit Kwetu address; Tribe Hotel page mentions only a spa; Ritual Studio (UN Crescent) could not be opened. Status is 'operating' only where an own page or news item dated 2025-2026 supports it; everything else is 'unknown'. 32 unverified leads are listed with reasons (hotel pages blocked, single-directory entries, listicle-only names). Seed venues in the box that I did not re-check (e.g. Smart Gyms, Colosseum, Hyat, Alpha Fit, Hyatt Place) are untouched. Savannah Fitness Exchange (State House Crescent) is out of this group's areas.
